svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.text: PR #1878 · Remove the lenient ClaudeMessage fallback; unknown wire shapes are loud
ClaudeMessage kept a silent Unknown catch-all that could swallow a future wire shape;
parse is now strictly typed — anything without a renderer errs into the loud RawJson path.

g.text: ClaudeMessage::parse — never fails
typed ClaudeOutput → variant; wildcard → Unknown
untyped JSON → parse_local_frame → or Unknown again
the last #[serde(other)]-style catch-all left in the render path
Unknown carried no behavior
AgentFrame::parse: Ok(Unknown) | Err(_) — identical fall-through
dispatch rendered it as the same raw bubble Err reaches anyway
message_type_tag needed a dead Unknown arm + an always-false check
the risk: quiet swallowing
a future wire shape lands in a nondescript bubble labeled by nobody
no error, no signal a renderer is missing — folklore instead of a type
parse returns Result, honestly
from_output / from_value → Option; None → Err with a reason
the Deserialize impl shares the same dispatch — cannot drift
Unknown variant deleted; kind()/dispatch/tag arms fall away
one fall-through chain, all agents
Err → CodexEvent parse → MuseRecord parse → RawJson bubble
an unrenderable claude frame now walks the same road as any foreign one
message_type_tag is total over the enum — the compiler enforces coverage
unknown shapes fail visible
a new wire variant shows as a raw JSON bubble until it earns a renderer
rendered frames unchanged; frontend tests green (classifier updated)

svg.text: CodexEvent and MuseRecord keep their own Unknown variants — those are dispatch guards inside typed parsers, not silent catch-alls in the render path.
